brief:
Phil Gordon, national security adviser to former US Vice President Kamala Harris, has accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of deliberately obstructing a hostage-ceasefire agreement during 2024, Middle East Eye reported. Gordon alleged that Netanyahu's actions made reaching a deal "impossible" during that period.

The assertion aligns with previous claims that Netanyahu deliberately delayed negotiations. Gordon served as a key figure in the Biden administration's diplomatic efforts regarding the conflict.

title: Netanyahu blocked Gaza deal in 2024, Biden adviser says
